svg.title: AI features for PQA energy meter
svg.desc: A tiered map of AI capabilities organized by category for a Nucleo-H755ZI-Q + ADE9000 based energy meter
svg.text: AI feature map — PQA energy meter

g.text: Tier 1 — Edge AI (runs on-device, M7 core)
